metadata.scenario: A customer calls urgently to request immediate support for an injury sustained while exercising. Category: Urgent Request. Flags: urgent_request.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret, my name is Jennifer Taylor. I need urgent help for my grandmother. I’m sorry to hear that, Jennifer. Can you tell me what happened? She was exercising and fell. I think she might have hurt her wrist, and she needs immediate assistance. Of course, I understand the urgency. Is she currently in a safe location? Yes, she’s at home, but I’m worried she can’t move her wrist at all. I see. We can send a skilled nurse to assess her injury and provide care. How quickly can someone get here? Let me check our availability. We can have someone there within the next 30 to 45 minutes. That sounds great. What will the service cost? Our skilled nursing care is priced between $95 and $125 for a visit. Okay, that’s fine. I just want her taken care of. Can I have your grandmother’s address, please? Yes, it’s 123 Maple Street, Wichita, KS. Thank you. I’ve got that noted. Is your grandmother currently able to communicate? Yes, she is. I’ll stay with her until the nurse arrives. Perfect. I’ll also arrange for a follow-up visit to provide any additional care she may need after the assessment. That would be helpful, thank you. We can also discuss ongoing companion care or assistance with daily activities if needed. Yes, that could be beneficial for her. I’ll definitely consider that. Great! I’ll have our nurse brief you on possible ongoing support options when they arrive. Thank you so much, Margaret. I really appreciate your help! You’re welcome, Jennifer. I’m here for you. Our nurse will be on their way shortly. Thank you again! I’ll keep my phone close. Sounds good. You’ll hear from us soon. Take care! Bye! Goodbye!
